title: 第7章 碰壁帝国最强防线居然没人第8章 好好好我不当人了
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
“杀腐尸也没那么难嘛。”菲尔德信心大增，随手甩去剑上沾染的污血。
“领主大人小心！”
另一只半截身体的腐尸，趁着空档爬来，就要撕咬菲尔德的脚踝。关键时刻，阿诗娜抄起木轮车上的粪叉，狠狠搠入丧尸的脊背，将其钉死在地上。
“呼！干得好！”
菲尔德惊出一身冷汗，后退了数步，心脏咚咚狂跳，差一点就中招了！
虽说尸毒可以被教会的神职人员治好，但代价无比高昂，没有一百枚金币，别想治好。
勉强从剧烈的心悸中缓过来，菲尔德长舒一口气，揉揉阿诗娜的脑袋，感谢道“作为救命之恩，我会赏赐你一枚金币，阿诗娜！”
阿诗娜高兴坏了，眼睛都变得金光闪闪，她从小到大都没见过那么多钱“哎？真的吗？其实这是我应该做的。”
腐尸并不像恐怖片里的丧尸，只要用武器刺进他们的身体，就会对腐尸造成伤害。
更多的腐尸涌了上来，张牙舞爪地攻击木轮车围成的车墙。
但车队后面的奴隶们见腐尸并不强大，没法隔着木轮车对他们攻击。更何况他们的领主，以及那个弱不禁风的姑娘都敢反击，不少男人都拿起了农具，对车阵外的丧尸展开了反击。
菲尔德也不含糊，举剑继续杀敌。
随着血花一朵朵溅起，大量的腐尸倒在了农具和菲尔德的长剑之下。
“哇！”
与此同时，听得一声惨叫。康纳手下的一位骑兵，在踏阵时，被一只村妇打扮的腐尸揪住了披风，猛拽之下，骑兵双腿乱蹬地向后倒去。
“咔嚓~”
骤然的摔倒，骑兵的后脑勺磕在地上，立刻让这个倒霉蛋没了动静。
康纳气得怒骂一声“草！废物！”
更让他生气的是，菲尔德居然没有吓得屁滚尿流，而是在淡定地指挥奴隶们。
“把每具尸体的脑袋砍下来，然后堆积到一块，就地焚烧。”菲尔德一路上恶补腐化的知识，这些被腐化的人类，死后的尸体对环境有极大危害，放任不管，很快会形成新的污染源，菲尔德蹙眉，踌躇地望着远处连街天际的灰雾，“还没有抵达夜幕领，就碰到那么多丧尸，真不是个好兆头。”

虽说家族看自己不顺眼，要流放自己，但往尸堆里赶也太狠心了。
“多谢您的相助，大人。”
逃跑的难民跟见了亲爹似的，跪行上前，随后匍匐在菲尔德面前，亲吻他的靴子。
“愿战争之神照亮您的前程！”
菲尔德坦然接受，扫视了这些狼狈得像乞丐的难民，询问道“你们来自哪里？怎么会有如此多的腐尸，那些腐化生物，不应该被咔山要塞高耸的城墙挡住吗？”
content_en:
"It's not that difficult to kill the carrion." Field's confidence increased and he casually shook off the blood stained on his sword.
"Lord, be careful!"
Another half-body rotting corpse crawled over during the gap and was about to bite Field's ankle. At the critical moment, Ashina picked up the dung fork on the wooden wheel cart, stabbed it into the zombie's back, and nailed it to the ground.
"Phew! Good job!"
Field broke into a cold sweat and took a few steps back. His heart was beating wildly. He was almost hit!
Although corpse poison can be cured by church clergy, the cost is extremely high. Without a hundred gold coins, it is impossible to cure it.
After barely recovering from the severe heart palpitations, Field breathed a long sigh of relief, rubbed Asheena's head, and said thanks, "As a life-saving grace, I will reward you with a gold coin, Asheina!"
Ashina was so happy that her eyes were shining with gold. She had never seen so much money since she was a child. "Huh? Really? In fact, this is what I should do."
The rotting corpses are not like the zombies in horror movies. As long as a weapon is pierced into their bodies, the rotting corpses will be harmed.
More rotting corpses surged up, attacking the wall of wooden wheeled carts with their claws and teeth.
But the slaves at the back of the convoy saw that the carrion was not strong and could not attack them through the wooden wheel cart. What's more, their lord and the frail girl dared to fight back. Many men picked up farm tools and launched a counterattack against the zombies outside the car formation.
Field did not hesitate, raised his sword and continued to kill the enemy.
As blood splashed, a large number of rotten corpses fell under the farm tools and Field's sword.
"Wow!"
At the same time, a scream was heard. When one of Connor's cavalrymen was marching into battle, a rotting corpse dressed as a village woman grabbed hold of his cloak. The cavalryman's legs kicked wildly and he fell backwards under the tug.
"Click~"
Suddenly falling down, the back of the cavalryman's head hit the ground, immediately rendering the unlucky man motionless.
Connor was so angry that he yelled, "Fuck! Trash!"
What made him even more angry was that Field was not scared to death, but was calmly commanding the slaves.
"Cut off the heads of each corpse, then pile them together and burn them on the spot." Field replenished the knowledge of corruption along the way. The corpses of these corrupted humans are extremely harmful to the environment after death. If left unchecked, they will soon form new sources of pollution. Field frowned and looked hesitantly at the gray fog stretching from the street to the sky in the distance. "We haven't even reached the Night Territory yet, and we encountered so many zombies. It's really not a good sign."
Although his family disliked him and wanted to exile him, it would be too cruel to rush him into a pile of corpses.
"Thank you for your help, sir."
The fleeing refugee knelt forward as if he had met his biological father, then knelt in front of Field and kissed his boots.
"May the God of War illuminate your future!"
Field accepted it calmly, glanced at these refugees who were as embarrassed as beggars, and asked, "Where are you from? Why are there so many rotting corpses? Shouldn't those corrupting creatures be blocked by the towering walls of Kashan Fortress?"
